source: OpenClaw 2026.11.1 (`openclaw gateway run` under weft's tether), every frame verbatim but these placeholders: $RUN the run (chat.send's idempotencyKey), $KEY the session key, $FOLDER the node's folder, $HOME the private home, $TOOL the text the program's tool answered. Recorded on Node 24.22.2 with weft's own agent server and this adapter (adapter_openclaw.py, every frame each way logged: scratchpad gw/live.py, runs L-tool, L-permission, L-edit, L-resume against a local fake OpenAI-compatible model, gw/model.py; L-real against OpenRouter's openai/gpt-oss-120b), and with the probe client gw/probe.py (r1: OpenRouter's openai/gpt-oss-120b, its second message, the program's tool `lookup` through weft's plugin; q1: a model that could not be reached, the Gateway's final `chat` error; q2: `sessions.describe` of a key the Gateway never had). Cut by gw/build.py: the events of the turn's own run and every approval and question, without the Gateway's ticks, presence, health, session-list and chat-metadata broadcasts, its `chat` deltas and status lines (the same text and phases as its `agent` events), its `usage`, `run_status`, `item` and `command_output` streams, and all but the first three thinking pieces of each thought; `connect`'s hello-ok keeps type, protocol, server, auth and policy (its method and event lists and its snapshot are hundreds of names). A `tool` step stands where the plugin's call reached the route, an `await` step where the Gateway waited for this side's answer. Nothing is composed.
